section:rsi-specific-commands.location: src/actions/commandmode.ts, src/actions/managers.ts and each slice's commands table
section:rsi-specific-commands.note: every command of the generated table is registered by its slice and tracked as its own cmd: row (aliases resolve through the keymap)

cmd:manual.note: the generated manual (docs/manual/rsi-manual.md, compiled in and rendered with the transcript sanitizer) in an in-app reader with a section picker; j/k g/G scroll, q closes. :manual pdf opens the system print dialog (Save as PDF); :manual pager opens the same reader (a desktop has no pager)

cmd:rotation-abandon.note: AbandonBlockedRotation {session_id, provider?, model?, idempotency_key} for the open session, else the cursor row; provider[/model] parsed case-insensitively; the first run shows the TUI's notice and the same command within 10 s sends

cmd:manager-reseat.note: ReseatHarnessManager {project_id, provider, model?, effort: null, reason, provider_unavailable: true} for the session's project; <provider>[/<model>] <reason> required; run twice within 10 s to confirm

cmd:cold-restore.note: RestoreColdSession {session_id} for the open session, else the cursor row (the Archived view included); restored / already-live toast

cmd:cold-archive.note: GetColdArchiveStatus shown as the TUI's status and last-pass lines; run/stage, move, verify and compact send RunColdArchiveNow {mode}; move (deletes verified rows from the live database) asks first

cmd:blank.note: bare :blank opens the launch dialog; :blank <text> launches directly (the runtime claims the core launch action) on the :model default provider and model in the filtered project's directory

cmd:context.note: UpdateActiveTask {session_id, active_task}: :context <text> sets it (capped at 500 bytes on a character), bare :context clears it

cmd:split.note: substitute: the desktop window is one fixed split (session list beside the open session); :split moves the keys between the list and the transcript

cmd:only.note: substitute: closes the open overlay pane (terminal, file viewer, graph, manager or Issues view) as :close does; the list and session panes always stay

cmd:tabnew.note: substitute: a desktop tab is the project filter, so :tabnew opens the project picker

cmd:tabclose.note: substitute: returns the project filter to all projects

section:vim-commands-pass-through.note: substitute: the desktop has no modalkit windows; :split/:vsplit move the keys, :only and :close close the overlay pane, :tabnew/:tabclose/:tabnext/:tabprev drive the project filter (see each cmd row)
